extra_quotes: We implement MaskPE as a 32 × 32 weight-stationary systolic array with INT8 multiplication and INT32 accumulation.
All architectures are described in RTL and synthesized using Yosys/ABC [18] with the Nangate45 standard-cell library.
Weight-SRAM area uses FakeRAM45 memory macros [21], while memory energy is estimated from recorded accesses using Accelergy [22] energy coefficients.
At zero sparsity, the additional sparse-weight storage and control overhead increases energy by 2.6%.
